g.text: [OAUTH2] oauth2 field present in TSP config
retry up to 3 times (backoff) only if Sidecar is unreachable
[SUCCESS — FINAL] 200 with reason AEXR / ARFR / ARJR
[NO TRANSITION] 200 with reason REPR / RSPR, or no reason
State unchanged, nothing written to the DB.
No reason → outcome comes later through the async callback
[ALREADY APPLIED] RTP already in the state implied by the reason
idempotent no-op, nothing written to the DB
- Reason AEXR / ARFR / ARJR (Final states saved to ADX & deleted from MONGO)
- Reason REPR / RSPR or no reason (No transition / async callback)
[STATE CONFLICT] transition not allowed from current state
[NON-CONFORMANT] 4xx — missing StsRsnInf.Rsn / empty or unreadable body
- Service Provider invalid response (Unknown reason / Non-conformant 4xx)
[500 Internal Server Error] Server Error Cases
- Sidecar unreachable after retries / read timeout
[SP NOT FOUND] Provider not in registry
Provider not found in Service Registry
